question: Which figures seated on that throne must be visualized together?
premises: A lion-throne has been established in the visualization.
A great gaṇa seated there is also named.
inference: One should visualize Gaṇeśa and the great gaṇa seated on that throne.
uncertainties: Whether mahāgaṇam refers to a single figure or a group is ambiguous.
plain_english: Visualize Gaṇeśa and the great gaṇa seated on that throne.
